title: chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-dependencies group with 3 updates
body:
Bumps the dev-dependencies group with 3 updates: [happy-dom](https://github.com/capricorn86/happy-dom), [prettier](https://github.com/prettier/prettier) and [typescript](https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript). Updates `happy-dom` from 20.1.0 to 20.3.0
Release notes

Sourced from happy-dom's releases.

v20.3.0

:art: Features

  • Use RegExp to convert ASCII character casing to improve performance - By @​TrevorBurnham in task #1886

v20.2.0

:art: Features

  • Use Element.classList.contains() instead of splitting className in query selectors to improve performance as it's cached - By @​TrevorBurnham in task #1884

v20.1.1

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Fixes caching in querySelector() - By @​TrevorBurnham in task #1882
  • Avoid sort in querySelector() to improve performance - By @​TrevorBurnham in task #1882

  • 8b9f94e fix: #1882 Fixes caching and avoid sort in querySelector to improve perform...
  • e84b95a chore: #1541 Set time zone when running unit tests (#1879)
